name: dbhq
description: Free, open-source Claude Code and Codex tools by DBHQ

plugins.name: outlook-graph
plugins.description: A pack of Outlook skills - Microsoft 365 email and calendar via the Graph API (inbox, reply-all-safe replies, attachments up to 150 MB, calendar and availability), plus PST and live-mail extraction into integrity-verified markdown archives that stay current.

plugins.name: trello
plugins.description: A pack of Trello skills - board, list and card management, shopping-list aisle sort, board status digest, and cross-board due radar.

plugins.name: legwork
plugins.description: Decision research producing cited findings where every claim states how well it is supported. Judges a source by whether it fits the claim it backs rather than by its domain, counts corroboration only across genuinely independent sources reached from different search angles, and says plainly when the evidence cannot answer the question.

plugins.name: dovetail
plugins.description: Check whether a repository agrees with itself - broken links, dangling heading anchors, orphaned files, duplicate content and stale translations. Deterministic, seconds to run, and it never modifies the repo it scans.

plugins.name: verve
plugins.description: Strip AI tells from prose and put a human voice back, in British English. A catalogue of tells with before/after for each, four tone presets, three strength levels, and a scored exit gate where fidelity is a veto. Runs entirely in the conversation: no packages, no API key, no network call and no paid tier.

plugins.name: vela
plugins.description: Compiler-exact code search for .NET - where a symbol is defined, every reference, who calls it, and what a change breaks. Built on Roslyn, so Razor views and Blazor components are indexed rather than skipped. Deterministic, nothing resident, never modifies your repo.
